tools.name: get_price_forecast
tools.description: Einstein's dual-model machine-learning price forecast (Google TimesFM 2.5 + Kronos) for BTC, ETH, SOL or BNB, including whether the two models agree and the direction/drift each projects. Pre-computed every 4 hours; returns the cached run rather than triggering new inference.

tools.name: get_forecast_accuracy
tools.description: The measured, out-of-sample accuracy of Einstein's own price forecasts — MAPE and direction hit-rate per model, asset and horizon, scored after each forecast's horizon elapsed. Use this to decide how much weight to give a forecast.

tools.name: get_market_sentiment
tools.description: Multi-source market sentiment in one read: the crypto Fear & Greed index, CoinMarketCap’s variant, the traditional-market (CNN) Fear & Greed, and the Altcoin Season index. Useful for framing any "how is the market feeling" question.

tools.name: get_top_movers

tools.name: get_smart_money_flow

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_whales
tools.description: Consensus positioning of the largest Hyperliquid perp traders plus current funding rates — i.e. what big leveraged money is actually long or short, and what it costs to hold that side.

tools.name: get_polymarket_whales

tools.name: get_prediction_market_catalysts

tools.name: get_prediction_market_yields

tools.name: get_bitcoin_cycle_position

tools.name: check_token_safety

tools.name: get_congress_trades

tools.name: get_government_contracts

tools.name: get_analyst_accuracy
tools.description: Scored track record of public crypto commentators and influencers whose calls Einstein has graded against what actually happened. Ranked by measured hit-rate, not follower count.

tools.name: get_smart_money_inflow

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_allocation" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_launchpad_radar · Private data: check_token_safety, get_analyst_accuracy, get_smart_money_inflow, get_social_hype, get_launchpad_radar, forecast_chart, analyze_token_security, analyze_wallet, detect_mev, scan_launchpads, analyze_bitcoin, generate_quantum_key, find_yield, check_content_integrity · Public sink: get_launchpad_radar, generate_quantum_key · Destructive: get_price_forecast, forecast_chart, run_backtest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_launchpad_radar · Private data: check_token_safety, get_analyst_accuracy, get_smart_money_inflow, get_social_hype, get_launchpad_radar, forecast_chart, analyze_token_security, analyze_wallet, detect_mev, scan_launchpads, analyze_bitcoin, generate_quantum_key, find_yield, check_content_integrity · Public sink: get_launchpad_radar, generate_quantum_key · Destructive: get_price_forecast, forecast_chart, run_backtest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
